title: INVOL Tool � Agent with ACNP (SK ACNP / CX ACNP) � Promise Stays at 14-Day Mark � Eligible
description:
A Contact Center or Airport agent changed the customer's flight WITH the ACNP (Air Canada No Pay) marker present. Identifier: SK ACNP or CX ACNP in PNR history. The presence of ACNP indicates the change was airline-initiated accommodation (INVOL), not a customer-requested change. Promise does NOT update.
